categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in integrated circuit (IC) packaging and testing services. Its main business segments include IC packaging, wafer testing, and final product testing, with packaging accounting for approximately 83.5% of revenue and testing 16.5%. The company also engages in design, domestic and international product agency, and import-export trade related to these services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced IC packaging technologies including traditional packaging (P-DIP, TO, SOT, QFP/LQFP), QFN, Bumping, multi-chip packaging, BGA, LGA, RDL, WLCSP, Flip Chip, MIS substrate packaging, and SiP. It develops high-density, fine-pitch, and multi-die packaging technologies, with ongoing R&D in third-generation semiconductors (SiC, GaN), power TOLT packages, and advanced wire bonding (Al and Cu wires). The production emphasizes automation, AI integration, and process efficiency improvements.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are Taiwan-based IC design companies, accounting for about 62.47% of sales, with the remainder exported mainly to Asia (16.09%), Americas (13.44%), and Europe (8.00%). End markets include consumer electronics, PCs, smartphones, wearable devices, automotive electronics, industrial control, IoT, and data centers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan with headquarters and multiple factories located in Miaoli County. Its sales are global, with significant exports to Asia, the Americas, and Europe. The company also collaborates with international customers and suppliers across Japan, Singapore, Korea, China, Malaysia, the USA, and the Philippines.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain, providing IC packaging and testing services. It sources raw materials such as lead frames, molding compounds, gold wire, copper wire, and silver paste from upstream suppliers and delivers finished packaged ICs and tested products downstream to semiconductor design and manufacturing companies.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing third-generation semiconductor packaging capabilities (GaN, SiC), developing Flip Chip with SMT processes, power TOLT products, and high-density packaging solutions like SiP and WLCSP. The company emphasizes AI technology integration and automation to improve production efficiency and product quality. R&D investment is about 1.9% of revenue, focusing on high-pin-count, fine-pitch, multi-die, and automotive-grade packaging technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of IC packaging and testing services. The company offers turnkey solutions integrating packaging, wafer testing, final testing, and tape & reel services, providing comprehensive one-stop services to customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors in packaging include ASE Technology, SPIL, HuaTai, and Lingsen; in testing, competitors include Siliconware Precision, King Yuan Electronics, and Nanya Technology. The company positions itself as a competitive player focusing on diversified global customers, advanced packaging technologies, and turnkey services to differentiate from low-cost competitors, especially from China.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$15.2 billion, a 12.1% increase from the previous year, with net profit growing 25% to about NT$2.5 billion. The company maintains a healthy financial structure with a low debt ratio (~14%) and strong liquidity (current ratio ~344%). It has a market share of about 2.44% in Taiwan's IC packaging and testing industry and shows steady growth aligned with the expanding semiconductor market.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes integrity, pragmatism, innovation, and quality as its core values. It offers a comprehensive product portfolio with advanced packaging technologies and turnkey services, enabling customers to reduce time-to-market and costs. Its proximity to major Taiwanese semiconductor customers and strong R&D capabilities allow it to provide high-quality, customized solutions with improved production efficiency and environmental sustainability.
